results.title: Jeweller targeted: Four rounds fired at car in Soro, robbers flee
results.description: A major robbery attempt targeting a jewellery shop owner was foiled near Paduna in Soro , Odisha after four miscreants allegedly opened fire at his car late Sunday night. The accused arrived on motorcycles and fired four rounds at the vehicle while the jeweller was returning home after closing his shop at Kupari market. However, they failed to loot the jewellery and fled the spot. According to the complaint, the jeweller was travelling home from Kupari market when the four miscreants allegedly intercepted his car near Paduna. They opened fire at the vehicle in an apparent attempt to carry out the robbery. Four Rounds Fired At Car The attackers reportedly fired four rounds at the car. Despite the firing, they could not carry out the robbery and loot the jewellery. The identity of the four miscreants is yet to be established. Police Begin Probe On getting information, police reached the spot and began an investigation into the firing and attempted robbery. Officials are examining the circumstances surrounding the incident and trying to trace the accused. Also Read: Wanted hot rotis, got into a fight! Two arrested for hotel attack in Bhubaneswar Police are also looking into the sequence of events and gathering information that could help identify the attackers. There are no reports of any injuries in the firing incident.

results.title: ‘I used to find it funny’: Ankur Warikoo recalls his father’s habit of saving warranty cards and what he understood years later
results.description: Ankur Warikoo recalled how his father carefully saved every warranty card, from mixers and fans to their first music system and colour TV. He once found the habit funny but later understood it reflected a life of scarcity, where replacing things was never easy. His emotional reflection highlights a generational shift: “They spent their life surviving. So that we could spend our life buying.”

results.title: Hindustan Copper Q1 Results: PAT zooms 163% YoY to Rs 353 crore; revenue rises to Rs 937 crore
results.description: Hindustan Copper reported a 163% year-on-year jump in Q1FY27 net profit to Rs 353 crore, while revenue from operations rose 81.4% to Rs 936.5 crore. EBITDA more than doubled to Rs 507.5 crore from Rs 212.3 crore, with EBITDA margin expanding to 54% from 41% a year earlier, the state-owned miner said in a regulatory filing.
